name: Add a Comment to a Jira Issue
description: Adds a comment to a Jira issue. Converts plain text to Atlassian Document Format (ADF) automatically. Supports optional visibility restrictions (group or role).

jiraCloudId.description: Jira Cloud site ID (UUID). Get it via the Get Sites action.

comment.description: Comment text (plain text, auto-converted to ADF)

visibilityValue.description: Group name or role name to restrict visibility to

steps.name: Post the comment to the issue
